newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Surgutneftegaz sees no new ADR issue before May 24.
newsitem.headline: Surgutneftegaz sees no new ADR issue before May 24.

text.p: Russian oil company Surgutneftegaz will not issue American Depositary Receipts (ADRs) on its preferred shares before a shareholders meeting on May 24, the head of the firm's securities department said Thursday.
"The process of issuing ADRs is a fairly long one. Anyway, what I can say is that there will not be an issue before the shareholders meeting," Anton Molchanov told Reuters.
The company has already issued ADRs on its ordinary shares.
Companies which issue ADR programmes tend to outperform the Russian shares market.
Shares in the vertically integrated oil company were last trading at $0.675 at 1350 GMT on the Russian Trading System, down from Wednesday's close of $0.685.
